mapper.select: SELECT source_relation_id, entity_no, source_type, source_client_id, source_partner_id, client_source_basis, status, active_source_slot, effective_from, effective_to FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) ORDER BY source_relation_id
mapper.sql: (SELECT NULLIF(COALESCE(o.legal_name, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', i.given_name, i.middle_name, i.family_name))), '') FROM t_party_profile pp LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id = pp.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id = pp.profile_id WHERE pp.party_id = ${partyColumn})
mapper.select: SELECT s.entity_no AS entityNo, e.status AS entityStatus, AS legalName, s.source_relation_id AS sourceRelationId, s.status AS sourceStatus, s.effective_from AS effectiveFrom, s.effective_to AS effectiveTo FROM t_entity_source_relation s JOIN t_operating_entity e ON e.entity_no = s.entity_no WHERE s.source_type = 'PARTNER' AND s.source_partner_id = #{localPartnerId} ORDER BY s.entity_no, s.effective_from
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE source_type = 'PARTNER' AND source_partner_id = #{localPartnerId} AND active_source_slot = 1
